title: VaultInventory
description: Result of the vault.inventory JSON-RPC method. One row per stored secret. The name is the secret's own (ADR-0016) — the vault owns it — with a fallback to the derived label or the kind when it did not land. The row id is an opaque renderer-addressable handle, never a secret reference (nocx-jb20.1).

entries.description: Every secret the vault holds, referenced or not. Never null: an empty vault is [].

id.description: Opaque row handle (secrow:...), minted by the backend from the secret's own id. The renderer may hold this; it is not a secret reference, routes nothing, and is the address rename takes.

name.description: The secret's display name, owned by the vault. Never blank, never the secret reference: falls back to the derived label where an owner exists, and to the kind otherwise.

kind.description: What the material is. The closed vocabulary of the registry (spec §4.1); a new kind is an addition, not a degradation into 'unknown'.

provider.description: Provider tag from the secret reference: sec:v1:<provider>:<32 hex>.

ownerId.description: Credential that references this secret, or empty for a secret no connection uses — which ADR-0016 exists to make possible.

usedBy.description: How many connections reference the owning credential. 0 for an unowned secret.

reachable.description: Whether the store that holds this secret answered its last probe.
